_comment: THE FRENCH DEMO STUDIO (fictional, npm run sandbox -- --country FR): "Atelier Vélin" does not exist; domains in .example (RFC 2606), a phone in a range reserved for fiction. Do not edit this file: create your agency in the cockpit (npm run backoffice, then ⋯ › Settings: it writes agency.config.json, which git ignores), or copy this file to agency.config.json and edit the copy. Until agency.config.json exists, this demo studio is the agency; npm run doctor lists what still belongs to the demo. Everything that speaks in your name reads it (legal mail footer, HELO, User-Agent, invoices, sales mail, signature).
_keys: brand keys keep their French names (read by the code): brand.expediteur = your first name, the sender of the emails; brand.team = one paragraph about your agency; brand.offer = what you offer, in one line; brand.garantie = your promise (a guarantee), in one line. Write them in your agency's language.
_country: country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2): company registry (SIRENE when FR), legal mail footer per country, phone formats, TLD guesses. language: the language of the generated sites, mails and call scripts. US example: agency.config.example.us.json.
name: Atelier Vélin

http._comment: userAgent: open-data APIs (Overpass, the company registry) ask callers to identify themselves with a way to reach you; crawlerUserAgent: reading the prospects' sites.

brand._comment: Brand facts of the SALES MAIL (generate-savior skill). Stay factual: no team, figure or review you do not have.
brand.team: un petit studio web indépendant qui conçoit et met en ligne des sites pour les artisans et les PME
brand.offer: un site refait de A à Z, mis en ligne et suivi : textes, photos, référencement local et prise de rendez-vous
brand.garantie: aucun acompte : vous ne payez que si le nouveau site vous convient

invoice._comment: Default seller printed on invoices, before the settings entered in the cockpit (Billing page). Replace the <...> placeholders. Free-text keys: France uses siret / tva / rcs / iban / bic / capital; a US studio uses taxId (EIN) and legal = entity type.

seller.name: Atelier Vélin
seller.legal: <legal form and share capital / forme juridique et capital>
seller.address: <street, postcode, town / n° et rue, CP, ville>
seller.tva: <EU VAT number / TVA intracom, FRXX XXXXXXXXX>

leadengine._comment: searchFallback: when the guessed domain does not answer, look the company up on DuckDuckGo then Bing (HTML result pages). Off by default: reading result pages programmatically falls outside the engines' terms of use. Enable knowingly (docs/GUIDE.md).

outreach._comment: competitorClaims: sentences the draft (outreach/scripts/draft.ts) may say about a NAMED competitor. Empty: no competitor line at all. Only put a true, verifiable fact here: an invented claim about an identifiable third party is a misleading commercial practice.
